Yes it can be very confusing. In France Le Bourget would be referred to as LBG. 
But ICAO (International Civil Aviation Organization) refers to Le 
Bourget as LFPB. Same place different identifiers. Pilots always 
refer to Le Bourget as LFPB. But if you search for hotels at LFPB 
you won't find any, you have to search for hotels under LBG! 
On Tue, Nov 8, 2016 at 7:39 AM, 
wrote: 
WOW! that is some alphabet going on! (ha! but I get it!) thanks 
On Nov 8, 2016, at 7:37 AM, Dave Rodgers 
wrote: 
CDG is for the Airlines. 
LBG is for General Aviation. They are less than 5 miles apart. LFPB is the 
same place as LBG, it's the ICAO name for Le Bourget.
